summary: Small contract whose text is dominated by immutables read as 0 (calculateInterestRates always reverts); the rest is faithful but noisy: a dead exponentiation loop and duplicated call arms, unfolded contradictions, and one getAPR() call lost to the unknown free-memory pointer.
